title: Marker Sketch of Fritz
content: Fritz is an autonomous, sentient drone called a "hoverhead" based on the design of a ceratopsian, fromDinotopia: First Flight(1999). Note that his trim is dented and he's missing the chrome ring around his right eye.For those of you who like to paint old, dented things, the "Dead Vehicle Challenge" is going strong with lots of great entries already. Deadline is the end of the month.Check it out on the Facebook event page.-----Get a copy of the expanded editionDinotopia: First Flightwhich has a behind-the-scenes supplement for no extra charge.
